title: Week 1 progress — Prototyping a webtoon-style story system for my game
author: acXes
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on my game for a while, and this week I decided to focus on how the narrative actually unfolds. I’m really not a fan of traditional cutscenes, so I decided to experiment with building a webtoon-style storytelling system where players progress through the story panel by panel. It's still super early and there's no real gameplay loop yet. I'm mainly just trying to figure out whether this comic-book format actually feels good to play.

For the artwork, I've been using Google Flow to generate the comic panels. The biggest challenge by far has been trying to keep the characters, environments, and overall visual style consistent as the story moves from one frame to another. 

Would love to hear some honest feedback or thoughts on this kind of storytelling format. Has anyone else experimented with webtoon-style UI in their games?
